Subject: Follow-up: deployment mode & dedicated sizing for NovumPay

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Summary of asks: evaluate deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem) and a preliminary dedicated sizing for your peak inference workload.
- From today's discussion we heard: production goal is a low-latency payments NLP feature with ~60 sustained TPS and short bursts to ~150 TPS for minutes at a time.
- Open questions we need from you to finalize sizing:
  - Confirm peak sustained TPS and average latency SLO (p95 target)
  - Typical token mix (avg input tokens, avg generated tokens) and request concurrency expectations
  - Any VPC/air-gapped or specific KMS/HSM requirements

Our initial recommendation (post-call): Dedicated capacity is likely the best fit given predictability and data isolation needs, with a follow-up technical deep-dive to lock GPU class (A100/H100/L4), instance counts, and caching strategy.

Attachments: sending a lightweight capacity worksheet (capacity_worksheet.xlsx) and a rough TPS profile (rough_tps_profile.csv) to capture your traffic patterns — please fill in the shaded cells and return.

Next steps proposed:
- You fill the worksheet and reply with any clarifications (if possible by end of week)
- Schedule a 45-min infra deep-dive with our solutions engineer (Evelyn) to validate network/KMS and run through concurrency scenarios

Would love to get a couple times that work for you next week.

Thanks,
David Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Follow-up: deployment mode & dedicated sizing for NovumPay

David —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side that should help you size things: 

- Traffic profile: baseline ~50–70 TPS during US business hours, with predictable morning spikes to ~120–150 TPS lasting 2–8 minutes. We expect growth to ~90 sustained TPS within 3 months.
- Token mix: average user request is ~250 tokens in (preprocessed prompt) and ~600 tokens out (model generation) -> ~850 tokens per request on average.
- Concurrency: we expect around 40–60 concurrent active sessions during peaks; individual requests are mostly single-turn but we keep KV cache per session.
- Security: we need VPC peering and customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest. SOC 2 is required (we confirmed you have a report).

Questions:
1) Do you recommend Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) or Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) given our need for customer-managed KMS and SOC 2?
2) For Dedicated, what GPU family would you start with (A100 vs H100 vs L4) for the 850-token average with our TPS profile?
3) Can you provide a rough committed-cost band for the starting configuration (ballpark monthly)?

Happy to schedule the deep-dive. Sara and I are available Wed 9/23 10:00–12:00 PT or Thu 9/24 14:00–16:00 PT.

—Michael
Michael Chen
Head of ML Engineering | NovumPay
From: david_kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: deployment mode & dedicated sizing for NovumPay

Michael —

Appreciate the data — very helpful. High-level answers to your questions and an initial sizing sketch below.

1) Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private
- Given the need for customer-managed KMS and SOC 2, you have two realistic paths: Dedicated with VPC peering + customer-managed KMS (we support BYOK/HSM integrations) OR Private (customer-managed control plane/on-prem) if you need full network isolation. Dedicated gives a faster time-to-production and predictable throughput; Private is chosen when regulatory or air-gap requirements exist.

2) GPU family recommendation (based on 850 tokens/request):
- Start: 4 x A100 80GB (mixed with autoscale buffer) — A100 gives strong memory headroom for KV caching and long-context models, good cost/perf for your token mix.
- If your priority is absolute lowest latency at high concurrency and you have budget, H100 nodes (2–3) can be a higher-throughput option but at higher unit cost.
- L4s can be considered for lower-cost inference if you move to a smaller distilled model; not recommended for your initial quality needs.

3) Preliminary sizing and throughput notes:
- Baseline config: 4x A100 80GB in a dedicated pool with continuous batching and prefix KV caching. Expect sustained ~60–80 TPS with p95 latency in the 120–300ms range depending on prompt complexity and batching.
- Burst handling: autoscale/burst to additional instances to cover short spikes to ~150 TPS; we can configure fast scaling policies for your peak patterns.
- Concurrency: target a pool sized to handle 50 concurrent sessions with token-aware batching.

Attachments: I attached the capacity_worksheet.xlsx and rough_tps_profile.csv filled with our initial assumptions; please correct numbers we guessed. Also attaching a short pricing overview PDF for Dedicated (redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf).

Next steps:
- Can you confirm which of the two security paths (Dedicated w/ BYOK vs Private) you want us to prioritize?
- Choose a deep-dive slot (we have Wed 9/23 10:30–11:15 PT available) — Evelyn will run the infra checklist.

If helpful, we can include a quick cost delta estimate (monthly committed range) ahead of the deep-dive.

Best,
David
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
